name: Lin and Roco

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Lin and Roco may use Ruin Actions, and have 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Partners in Crime
bonuses.text: Lin and Roco are so inseparable they share the same profile. Whenever Lin makes a melee attack, Roco can make a ranged attack without a Multi-Action penalty, and vice versa. Roco may make a ranged attack even whilst Engaged, and does not need to target the character he is Engaged with.

bonuses.name: Avalanche of Muscle
bonuses.text: Lin gains +2d to melee attacks when Charging.

abilities.name: Unstable Mounting
abilities.text: When Lin and Roco roll a Complication, Roco's precarious position atop Lin has been compromised. They cannot make a ranged attack next turn, as Roco scrambles back to safety and recovers his wits. Agents may also trigger this Complication if they successfully make a Called Shot against a Small target.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (Champion pair with 2 personal Ruin, 8 Wounds). One profile for two characters (Ogryn Lin, Ratling Roco). Faction imperial is a placeholder: no IMPERIUM keyword printed (SCUM, ABHUMAN).
